// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// expressions / values / expression blocks
const label = if (ready) {
//            ^^ keyword.control.conditional.ds
    "ready"
} else {
    "waiting"
};

// expressions / values / tuples
const pair = (left, right);
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

const one = (value,);

// expressions / values / do expressions
const value = do {
//            ^^ keyword.control.loop.ds
    let base = 1;
    base + 2
};
